title: Derived base change for a bounded relatively flat complex
statement: Let f:X\to S be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], and let G^\bullet be a bounded-above complex of quasi-coherent \mathcal O_X-modules flat over S. For every morphism g:T\to S, with base change g':X_T\to X and f_T:X_T\to T, the canonical map Lg^*Rf_*(E\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_X}G^\bullet) [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image] \to Rf_{T,*}(L(g')^*E\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_{X_T}}(g')^*G^\bullet) is an isomorphism in D(\mathcal O_T).
